# Filter rows where Height is over 1.8 meters
# The Height column contains strings like "1.83 m (6 ft 0 in)". We need to extract the numeric part before "m".
# Convert the numeric part to float and compare to 1.8
df['height_numeric'] = df['Height'].str.extract(r'(\d+\.\d+)').astype(float)
over_180 = df[df['height_numeric'] > 1.8]
# Count unique candidates (rows) that satisfy the condition
answer = len(over_180)
